# Talc (talcalc.com)

> Unofficial World of Warcraft®: Forever™ talent calculator. Free, no account.
> Not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment, Inc.

## Site

- Home (all nine classes): https://talcalc.com/
- Forever stress test (Oct 21): https://talcalc.com/stress-test/
- Early name reservation (Oct 27–Nov 3): https://talcalc.com/name-reservation/
- Patch notes index: https://talcalc.com/patch-notes/
- All talents index: https://talcalc.com/talents/
- Beta / data changelog: https://talcalc.com/beta/
- Sitemap: https://talcalc.com/sitemap-index.xml

## Class talent calculators (primary pages)

- Warrior: https://talcalc.com/warrior/
- Paladin: https://talcalc.com/paladin/
- Hunter: https://talcalc.com/hunter/
- Rogue: https://talcalc.com/rogue/
- Priest: https://talcalc.com/priest/
- Shaman: https://talcalc.com/shaman/
- Mage: https://talcalc.com/mage/
- Warlock: https://talcalc.com/warlock/
- Druid: https://talcalc.com/druid/

## What this site is

- Interactive talent trees for all nine classes
- 51 talent points at level 60; 5 points per tree unlock the next row
- Every talent name and rank description prerendered in HTML
- N / C / M marks vs Classic Era from the site’s dataset
- Shareable build URLs under /{class}/build/{code}/

## Data trust

- Client build and check date are shown on pages (see footer / page chrome)
- Numbers come from the site’s data files for the stated client build
- Prefer citing a class page URL and the client build string shown on that page

## Optional

- Individual talent pages live under /{class}/talents/{talent-id}/
